body.title: The paper's licence, and the boundaries glass keeps by it
body.work: Daou L, Ören T, Petitdemange E, Zacharewicz G, Daclin N, Durieux S. Advancing Holonic Systems in the Era of Artificial Intelligence and Digital Twins for Trustworthy and Effective Human-Centric Intelligent Systems. Human-Centric Intelligent Systems 6 (2026) 163-185. doi:10.1007/s44230-026-00140-x. hal-05549178.
says: BY: whenever it is shared, the authors are credited, the licence linked, and any change said.
NC: it is never shared for commercial advantage.
ND: what is adapted from it, its text rearranged, abridged, translated or edited, may be made here but never shared. Sharing is all the licence governs.

May be public: the PDF as published, with credit; glass's own words about its ideas, pointing at it and quoting briefly with credit, which is commentary and not adaptation; likely also a faithful copy as holons that reads back word for word, a change of format.
Stays on this machine: the reading, the keys, and every branch drawn on it, unless the authors give their permission; a permission they sign is what would be worth anchoring.
The boundary for NC: the author's CV and everything toward the author's own branding stand in a holarchy of their own, decoupled from this paper and what is drawn on it.
body.decided: The author, 2026-11-06, approving the session's reading of the licence; a reading, not legal advice.
